summary: This manuscript presents a machine-checked, zero-floating-point formalization and exact-rational certificate auditor (HYPERGRAPH-BLOWUP-CERT-1.0) for the finite link-copying, pattern-entropy, distinct-vertex, and almost-monochromatic core of Mubayi's breakthrough in extremal hypergraph theory. Featuring an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice) and exhaustive empirical verification across 16 canonical certificates and 60/60 red-team adversarial forgeries, the work achieves exceptionally high standards of formal rigor and verification transparency.
weaknesses: Scope is explicitly restricted to the finite combinatorial and rational inequality core, leaving real-analytic fractional-exponent Holder/AM-GM integrals and probabilistic Chernoff bounds outside Lean 4.
Computational verification of exhaustive list choices scales combinatorially for larger parameters.
